events.title: MTV launched
events.blurb: Music Television, MTV, launched in the US on this day in 1981, with The Buggles' 'Video Killed The Radio Star' being the first music video ever aired.

angles.name: MTV Launch Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember the day music changed forever? On this day in '81, MTV hit the airwaves, kicking off with a track that ironically declared 'Video Killed The Radio Star'. The irony isn't lost on us.

events.title: Oasis released Definitely Maybe
events.blurb: Oasis released their debut album 'Definitely Maybe' on this day in 1994, featuring classic tracks like 'Supersonic' and 'Live Forever'.

angles.name: Definitely Maybe Anniversary
angles.copy: Thirty-two years ago today, Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe' and changed the sound of British music. Still sounds as fresh and vital as ever.

events.title: Woodstock Festival began
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in music history, kicked off on this day in 1969 in upstate New York.

angles.name: Woodstock Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, a field in upstate New York became the epicentre of a cultural revolution. Woodstock began today in '69, a moment that defined a generation.

events.title: Elvis Presley's passing
events.blurb: The music world remembers Elvis Presley, who passed away on this day in 1977.

angles.name: Elvis Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the King of Rock and Roll. On this day in 1977, we lost Elvis Presley, but his music and legacy continue to shake, rattle, and roll.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's passing
events.blurb: The music world remembers guitar legend Jimi Hendrix, who passed away on this day in 1970.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: Fifty-six years ago, we lost a true guitar visionary. Remembering Jimi Hendrix, whose innovative sound continues to inspire generations.

events.title: The Beatles released Abbey Road
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' on this day in 1969, featuring the famous zebra crossing cover.

angles.name: Abbey Road Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover alone is legendary, let alone the tracks within.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the one and only Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as hard as ever.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and rock icon Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54 today! Happy Birthday to the inimitable Liam Gallagher. Still got that swagger.

events.title: John Lennon released 'Imagine'
events.blurb: John Lennon released his iconic album 'Imagine' on this day in 1971, featuring the timeless title track.

angles.name: Imagine Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-five years ago, John Lennon gave us 'Imagine', an album that dared us to dream of a better world. Its message still resonates.

events.title: Apple released the first iPod
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first generation iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: iPod Launch Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember life before the iPod? Twenty-five years ago today, Apple launched a device that changed how we listen to music forever.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th is celebrated annually as James Bond Day, marking the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day
angles.copy: Shaken, not stirred. It's James Bond Day! Celebrating 007's enduring legacy since 'Dr. No' premiered on this day in 1962.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The legendary John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: John Lennon Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the incomparable John Lennon. Imagine the music he might still be making.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Renowned actor and comedian John Cleese, famous for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: And now for something completely different... Happy 87th Birthday to the legendary John Cleese! A true titan of British comedy.

events.title: The Beatles released 'The White Album'
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago, The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album' – a sprawling, eclectic masterpiece that proved they could do anything.
